title: typesafe.systemone.request.v1
description: NOT the integration path used by this project -- see openrouter.decisions.request.v1.schema.json for that. This documents TypeSafe's own direct API (POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone), kept for background because OpenRouter's alpha/decisions endpoint is a thin proxy over the same choice/score/noul primitive contract (docs/PI/pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 4). decisionsService.ts (M3) targets OpenRouter, not this endpoint.

state.description: Content to evaluate. In this project: the allowlist projection carried in pi.decisions.request.v1.state_projection.

model.description: Pinned version (e.g. jev-1.13.0) for released policy; jev-latest/jev-preview are aliases and must not be used once confidence thresholds are calibrated against a specific version (docs.typesafe.ai/models.md).

criteria.description: Not used by this project (M0-M7 only emits choice/noul questions); documented for wire-format completeness.
